data_points.source_name: IndexBox (South Korea face sunscreen SPF50 market report)
data_points.notes: Daily face sunscreen (SPF50) penetration stated as 'exceeding 75%' among core demographic of KR women aged 18-55; recorded at 75 (floor of stated range). Aggregator estimate; SPF50 positioned as standard daily protection level in KR.

45% of Korean youth (ages 19-29) use sun protection every day regardless of weather. Source itself flags this stat as 'directional' confidence. Conflicts with IndexBox 75%+ (different demographic: youth both sexes vs women 18-55) — both retained.

South Korea sun care cosmetics market, USD 330.3mn 2024, projected USD 684.3mn by 2033. GVR's own page returns 403; figure verified on the ResearchAndMarkets listing of the same report. CONFLICTS with MarkNtel USD 747mn 2025 (2.3x gap) - definitional mismatch unresolved; do not reconcile without scope check.
CAGR 8.3% 2025-2033, from USD 330.3mn (2024) to USD 684.3mn (2033). Contrast MarkNtel CAGR 3.59% 2026-2032 for nominally the same market.

South Korea sun care products market: USD 747mn 2025, USD 805mn 2026, USD 995mn 2032. CONFLICTS with Grand View USD 330.3mn 2024 (2.3x gap) - definitional mismatch unresolved. MFDS production value for sunscreen (KRW 470.3bn 2025, ~USD 318mn) sits between the two but is PRODUCTION basis, not retail.
CAGR 3.59% 2026-2032. Contrast Grand View 8.3% 2025-2033 for nominally the same market.

MFDS CY2025 production statistics: sunscreen products KRW 470.3bn production value (factory-gate, NOT retail, NOT export). ~USD 318mn at pinned USD/KRW 1478.40 (2026-07-21, config/exchange_rates.yaml). Context: functional cosmetics production total KRW 7.18tn (-2.3% YoY), 40% of total cosmetics production. MFDS origin relayed by trade press (article dated 2026-05), hence MEDIUM not HIGH.

Output value of sunscreen products grew +9.4% in CY2025 per MFDS production data (whitening products +9.7%), against a -2.3% decline in overall functional cosmetics production. PRODUCTION basis growth, not retail sell-through. Same MFDS release as the KRW 470.3bn production value claim.

Projected +43% on-year surge in US e-commerce sales of Korean sun care products in 2025 (Samsung Securities report). Export-demand indicator for Korean sun care, NOT KR domestic retail growth - destination market is the US, e-commerce channel only. Same article: Kolmar Korea saw +88% on-year surge in US-bound OTC sunscreen products in 2024. No sunscreen-specific customs export value published (sunscreen has no separate HS line; sits inside skincare, which was 74.7% of the USD 11.4bn CY2025 cosmetics export total).
